name: Dynamic Layout Short
tagline: A raw talking-head recording goes in, a vertical short that switches layout with what you say comes out.
description: A how-to short that never sits still: you alone for the big claims, split screen when you name something, the thing full-screen with you cut out in front when you show a process, and a step list that comes back at every new step. Pauses and earlier takes are cut out, and short captions sit where each layout leaves room.
bring: Your raw recording of you talking to camera, best with clear steps
Screen recordings, screenshots or photos of the things you talk about
Optional: the steps in a few words each
get: A 45–90 s vertical video that changes layout every few seconds, with captions

needs.name: Hyperframes, which also cuts you out of the background

stylesNote: colors, fonts, captions and the title and step cards
steps: Cut the pauses and keep the last take of every line
Give every few seconds of speech a layout
Prepare the pictures and cut you out for the full-screen parts
Build it from the template and add captions
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
